title: Fusion 2026: the funding is private, the gaps are physical
takeaway: Assembly is ahead of plan; the fuel cycle is not on the plan at all.

quotes.text: Neutron-resistant materials and a tritium breeding blanket remain unsolved at plant scale.
No defensible levelised cost figure exists yet.
The 2022 authorisation of $1.1B for FY2027 is a ceiling, not an appropriation.
